justification: Guardrail-only change: prior-art four-sweep rule in CLAUDE.md plus a PreToolUse hook gating Artifact publishes on a fresh sweeps marker. No product code, no DB access, no served output touched.
functions: N/A - one small hook script; no product functions changed.
values: N/A - no DB or API values involved.

break_it.scenario: The hook blocks legitimate Artifact listing calls, breaking artifact discovery.
break_it.what_happens: Sessions could not enumerate existing artifacts at all.
break_it.how: action list passes through unconditionally; smoke-tested (exit 0 for list, exit 2 for publish without marker).
break_it.repro: echo a list-action payload into the hook and observe exit 0.

break_it.scenario: A malformed or stale marker silently allows publishes, defeating the gate.
break_it.what_happens: The guard would be decorative, like the memory rule it replaces.
break_it.how: Unreadable markers, markers older than 4h, and markers lacking two sweeps plus a verdict all block with the reason named in stderr.
break_it.repro: Write an empty marker file and attempt a publish payload - exit 2 with marker must list sweeps.

post_merge.other_repo: None. Candidate for later porting to the claude-railguards public repo.
post_merge.manual_verify: Yes - next session: an Artifact publish without the marker is blocked with the sweep instructions; writing the marker then publishing succeeds.
